id.description: ID of the merchandising rule. Use this value to retrieve the rule details.

type.description: Discriminator identifying the merchandising rule variant and its corresponding detail configuration. Supported values are boostAndBury, fixedPosition, filter, and inputModifier.

name.description: Display name configured for the merchandising rule.

description.description: Description configured for the merchandising rule, or null when the rule has no description.

enabled.description: Whether the merchandising rule is enabled. A disabled rule is not applied to requests.

priority.description: Ordering value of the merchandising rule. Lower values appear earlier in the configured rule order, and list results are returned in this order.

group.description: Group configured for the merchandising rule, or an empty string when the rule does not belong to a group.

status.description: Current calculated rule status, or null when no status is available. This value is informational and may gain additional values in the future.

created.description: UTC date and time when the merchandising rule was created.

modified.description: UTC date and time when the merchandising rule was last modified.

description: Compact merchandising rule representation returned by list operations, including identity, state, ordering, grouping, schedule, and audit timestamps without detailed conditions or configuration.
